summary: `aap-gateway-manage revoke_oauth2_tokens` revokes all application tokens and PATs; add --revoke_refresh to also revoke refresh tokens, and --user <name> to limit it to one user.
questions: How do I revoke all OAuth2 tokens in AAP?
How do I revoke tokens for a single user?

answer_card.title: Revoke tokens with aap-gateway-manage
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
aap-gateway-manage revoke_oauth2_tokens                       # all tokens
aap-gateway-manage revoke_oauth2_tokens --revoke_refresh      # plus refresh tokens
aap-gateway-manage revoke_oauth2_tokens --user example_user   # one user
aap-gateway-manage revoke_oauth2_tokens --user example_user --revoke_refresh
```
Without `--revoke_refresh`, application refresh tokens are kept.
